review.why: Writes implementation plans for an engineer who has not seen the code: file map, right-sized tasks, one checkable action per step, test first.
review.summary: Plans assume a skilled reader without context, so they record decisions: files, names, signatures, values and the tests that prove each task. It covers scope checks, mapping file structure, right-sizing tasks around independent deliverables, step granularity (write the failing test, run it, implement, run, commit) and a required plan header pointing to the execution skills.
strengths: Each step is one action with a checkable result
Task boundaries are drawn where a reviewer could reject one but accept another
Splits multi-subsystem specs into separate plans
cautions: Produces long documents that may be heavy for small features
Tied to the companion execution skills
Later template sections were not read in full
